info.title: Ekmivo Payment API
info.description:
PG03 implemented contract: process liveness, financial readiness, and
real server-side merchant credential verification. Credential issue/rotate/
revoke currently use authenticated owner/admin Next.js server actions.
PG05 provides SANDBOX-ONLY standalone and server-priced linked order/invoice
snapshots, immutable payment intents, opaque hosted checkout, payer+route lock,
status refresh and cancellation. Full commerce/invoice operations, live
receiving instructions are
NOT released. PG06–PG09 source contracts are unverified and not deployed. No money verification
can be inferred from return URLs, payer confirmation or sandbox responses.

post.summary: Subscribe, verify or withdraw consent-based receipt email
post.description: Checkout capability and same-origin POST required. Contact never replaces payer. Subscription emails a purpose-scoped verification code; verification is single-use. SMTP acceptance is not inbox delivery or payment verification. Requires configured TLS SMTP and additive notice migration.

200.description: Contact verified or notice consent withdrawn; payment state unchanged

202.description: Verification email accepted by SMTP; contact is not yet verified

422.description: Invalid contact, consent or expired/reused code

503.description: Notice service unavailable or verification delivery outcome unconfirmed

200.description: Scoped masked items, at most 50, next_cursor; source unavailable is not an empty list.

post.description: Owner/admin only. Devices require account_id/name/source/binding/parser_id; gateways require method/account_number; webhooks require HTTPS url. Only mutation returns pairing_token/signing_secret.

200.description: Configuration persisted; once-visible capability where applicable
Scoped detail in items; deliveries uses resourceID as endpoint filter; notices uses resourceID as payment ID, excludes recipient ciphertext.

post.description: Owner/admin; valid transitions checked in PostgreSQL. Reprocess cannot approve funds. Replay delivers the same event without payment re-execution. Notice retry requires a 10-400 character reason and explicit authorization of possible duplicate email; never changes paid funds.

P-256 SHA256 DER Base64 over newline-delimited method/path/Unix-seconds timestamp/event ID/SHA256(raw-body) hex. Transport freshness ±300 seconds.
Claim body: pairing_token/public_key (X.509 DER Base64), signed by that key. Other bodies bind enrollment_id/environment to registered device.
Events: durable sequence >0, source/binding/kind (device_sms/device_notification)/evidence/observed_at. Full actual payer and original transaction time parsed server-side. No customer TrxID entry.
Offline retry preserves queued bytes/event ID/sequence and refreshes transport timestamp/signature. ACK means durable storage, not verified payment.

get.summary: Authenticate a scoped merchant API key without performing financial work
get.description:
Requires payments:read. Workspace, environment, expiry, revocation
and enabled Payments product are server verified. Keys are hash-only,
generated in the owner/admin dashboard and shown once. Sandbox and
Live credentials are never interchangeable.

parameters.description: Exact API-key environment. Not an authorization override.

403.description: Authenticated key cannot access required scope/environment

503.description: Credential database unavailable; safe to retry

get.summary: List issued immutable order/invoice source snapshots (sandbox only)

post.summary: Persist a real immutable merchant-issued source with server-calculated total
post.description:
Minimum PG05 sandbox document source of truth, not a complete invoice
system. Merchant authors the line prices, server computes sum(qty*unit)
and freezes the issued terms. NO caller-controlled total is accepted.
Requires payments:write and valid workspace/environment.

201.description: Immutable issued source with total computed by database

get.summary: List up to 50 tenant/environment-scoped issued requests

200.description: Authorized list of actual financial records

503.description: Financial database or live source unavailable

post.summary: Issue an immutable standalone or order/invoice-linked BDT request
post.description:
Server-side payments:write permission required. Linked requests include
only order_id OR invoice_id; the server resolves the exact amount from
its immutable tenant/environment-bound source. Caller-provided linked
amount is rejected. Same idempotency key plus identical payload returns
one original request; changed payload or duplicate reference conflicts.
No TrxID, payment screenshot, manual approval or client paid state.

201.description: Issued standalone payment request, not paid

404.description: Linked source absent from authorized realm

409.description: Duplicate reference or changed idempotency payload

422.description: Invalid amount, expiry, mixed source or caller-forged linked total

post.description: No refund or paid-state mutation occurs. Verified evidence processing is separate.

post.summary: Read-only TrxID-assisted lookup of an already verified payment
post.description: This request does not consume a transaction, verify raw SMS, charge a credit or mark money paid. It only reports an already uniquely matched, verified observation within the authenticated API key's workspace and environment.

200.description: Read-only status of uniquely matched payment for the requested intent

401.description: Missing or expired merchant API key

403.description: Read scope or workspace access denied

post.summary: Confirm actual payer, receiving method and immutable attempt window
post.description:
The full payer number is normalized server-side, persisted only as keyed
digest and last-four suffix. Repeating identical lock returns the same
attempt; changed payer/method or overlapping active evidence bucket is
409. This does not assert that money was sent or verified.
